newsitem.title: FRANCE: SOCCER-JACQUET PICKS FOUR UNCAPPED PLAYERS.
newsitem.headline: SOCCER-JACQUET PICKS FOUR UNCAPPED PLAYERS.

text.p: France coach Aime Jacquet has been forced to pick untested Franck Gava of Lyon and recall Spanish exile Michael Madar for the friendly against Turkey next Wednesday because of injuries to three strikers.
In all there are four uncapped players in his 18-man squad as the hosts of the next World Cup prepare for their second friendly of the season at Parc des Princes. They beat Mexico 2-0 on August 31.

With Nicolas Ouedec of Espanyol, who scored against Mexico last month, and Lyon's Florian Maurice recently injured and AC Milan's Christophe Dugarry a long-term casualty, Jacquet is looking elsewhere to improve the weakest department in his team.

The in-form Gava should get his chance even if only as a substitute. But only one out-and-out striker, probably Paris Saint-Germain's Patrice Loko, will start with his former club mate Youri Djorkaeff of Internazionale in "the hole" behind him.
Jacquet will also field a new man in defence, at present the strongest area of the team, after being deprived through injury of Athletic Bilbao's Bixente Lizarazu.
He has called up uncapped Alain Goma of Auxerre and Vincent Candela of Guingamp.
With Bernard Lama, a 33-cap veteran, unavailable in goal because of a recent cartilage operation, Monaco's Fabien Barthez should win his third cap.
Jacquet has overlooked Montpellier's 34-year-old Bruno Martini, for a long time his third choice goalkeeper, in favour of uncapped Christophe Revault of Le Havre.
In midfield, Auxerre's Sabri Lamouchi, a late substitution against Mexico, should come in from the start after his fine recent form for the French champions.
Goalkeepers - Fabien Barthez (Monaco), Christophe Revault (Le Havre)
Defenders - Laurent Blanc (Barcelona), Vincent Candela (Guingamp), Marcel Desailly (AC Milan), Alain Goma (Auxerre), Alain Roche (Paris Sain-Germain), Lilian Thuram (Parma)
Midfielders - Didier Deschamps (Juventus), Christian Karembeu (Sampdoria), Sabri Lamouchi (Auxerre), Reynald Pedros (Marseille), Zinedine Zidane (Juventus)
Forwards - Youri Djorkaeff (Internazionale Milan), Franck Gava (Lyon), Patrice Loko (PSG), Mickael Madar (Deportivo La Coruna), Robert Pires (Metz).
